item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single public 2024 document that cleanly ties the Smart Bangladesh program to a full cross-government budget annex, ministry-by-ministry KPI table, or cabinet-wide implementation calendar. The evidence is strongest for planning documents, procurement rules, and sector-specific institutions. It is much weaker for a whole-of-government translation into sustained appointments, budget priorities, and enforcement discipline.","evidence":[{"title":"AL unveils Smart Bangladesh manifesto","publisher":"BSS","date":"December 27, 2023","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news-flash/165179","summary":"Claim: Hasina set a concrete 2041 target for a “developed, prosperous, Smart Bangladesh” plus 2031 high-middle-income goals. This gives a program baseline that later 2024 actions could be measured against.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Full-text of the Awami League manifesto","publisher":"BSS","date":"December 27, 2023","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news/165180","summary":"Claim: the manifesto named four pillars and promised transparency, accountability, democracy, rule of law, human rights, and social equality. That is explicit program content, not just sloganizing.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Official document: govt to include Smart Bangladesh in mid-term dev plan","publisher":"Dhaka Tribune","date":"April 16, 2024","url":"https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/bangladesh/344095/official-document-govt-to-include-smart","summary":"Claim: the planning commission sought to embed Smart Bangladesh into the Ninth Five Year Plan with targets for macro stability, inflation control, jobs, poverty reduction, regional balance, and rule of law. This is one of the clearest signs the program was being translated into formal planning.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Govt adopts plan to turn public welfare services into smart services in two years","publisher":"UNB","date":"June 4, 2024","url":"https://www.unb.com.bd/category/Bangladesh/govt-adopts-plan-to-turn-public-welfare-services-into-smart-services-in-two-years/136812","summary":"Claim: the government moved 52 ministries/divisions into a Smart Bangladesh implementation platform for “smart” welfare services. This is concrete administrative rollout, though still mostly process-level.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Bangladesh Public Procurement Authority: e-GP mandatory","publisher":"BPPA","date":"March 6, 2024","url":"https://bppa.gov.bd/media-communication/news-1446.html","summary":"Claim: online procurement was made mandatory, with broad agency registration and improved transparency, efficiency, and competition. This is the clearest concrete enforcement mechanism I found for reducing discretion in a major state function.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Advancing healthcare excellence: WHO’s role in developing the first national medical education strategy in Bangladesh","publisher":"WHO Bangladesh","date":"March 4, 2024","url":"https://www.who.int/bangladesh/news/detail/04-03-2024-advancing-healthcare-excellence-who-s-role-in-developing-the-first-national-medical-education-strategy-in-bangladesh","summary":"Claim: the health ministry and WHO used workforce studies and a technical working group to build a medical-education strategy. This shows a real evidence-based institutional channel, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"2nd JEE Bangladesh","publisher":"WHO","date":"July 11, 2024","url":"https://www.who.int/southeastasia/news/detail/11-07-2024-2nd-jee-bn","summary":"Claim: Bangladesh completed a peer-reviewed Joint External Evaluation identifying strengths, gaps, and priority actions. That is a concrete measurement-and-correction mechanism inside the state.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"World Bank helps Bangladesh provide basic services, opportunities and build resilience for displaced Rohingya and host communities","publisher":"World Bank","date":"May 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/05/28/world-bank-helps-bangladesh-provide-basic-services-opportunities-and-build-resilience-for-displaced-rohingya-and-host-co","summary":"Claim: World Bank-backed projects funded health, nutrition, education, water, shelters, livelihoods, and GBV prevention for Rohingya and host communities. This is narrow but real evidence of prioritized policy execution for a vulnerable group.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"World Bank receives $900 million for resilience and growth reforms","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/21/bangladesh-receives-900-million-world-bank-financing-to-increase-economic-and-urban-resilience-for-sustainable-growth","summary":"Claim: the package included fiscal and financial-sector reforms, tax changes, procurement reform, and climate-resilient urban management. This is one of the clearest links between program and institutional reform.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Little election fizz in Bangladesh as prime minister set for another term","publisher":"Reuters","date":"January 4, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/little-election-fizz-in-bangladesh-as-prime-minister-set-for-another-term/1910693/","summary":"Claim: the opposition boycott followed Hasina’s refusal to resign and allow a neutral authority to run the election. That shows a clear regime-control priority, but not program translation into neutral institutions.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","7B.10"]},{"title":"New cabinet formation: loyalists, fresh faces likely to get priority","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"January 9, 2024","url":"https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/new-cabinet-formation-loyalists-fresh-faces-likely-get-priority-3515421","summary":"Claim: contemporaneous reporting said loyalists would likely be prioritized in the new cabinet, with technocrats rare. This weakens the claim that the program was being translated into a meritocratic executive team.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Hasina springs cabinet surprises","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://online.thedailystar.net/election-2024/news/news/hasina-springs-cabinet-surprises-3516291","summary":"Claim: Hasina did include two technocrats and some fresh faces, but the cabinet remained Awami League-heavy and still centered on trusted insiders. This is counterevidence, but only a limited one.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Claim: the response to protests was curfew, troop deployment, roadblocks, and internet/text shutdowns. That is an enforcement mechanism, but it looks like regime defense rather than program execution.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Claim: Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence. This is direct evidence of coercive crisis control and weak institutional accountability.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","7B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s internet shutdown isolates citizens, disrupts business","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladeshs-internet-shutdown-isolates-citizens-disrupts-business-3539448","summary":"Claim: the government imposed a countrywide internet blackout, a prior pattern around elections and unrest. This is a blunt enforcement tool, not a sign of transparent program implementation.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","7B.10"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s economy bogged down by high unemployment, inflation","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 8, 2024","url":"https://m.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/factboxtroubled-bangladeshs-economy-bogged-down-by-high-unemployment-inflation-3561503?ampMode=1","summary":"Claim: reserves fell, the taka depreciated, inflation stayed near 10%, and an IMF bailout was needed. That undercuts any claim that the macro program was being executed cleanly at scale.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"AL govt created lawless economy, crony capitalism captured public organizations","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"October 31, 2024","url":"https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/al-govt-created-lawless-economy-crony-capitalism-captured-public-organizations-3741796","summary":"Claim: a white-paper lead said authoritarian practices produced crony capitalism and elite capture of public organizations. That is strong evidence that program execution was subordinated to patronage.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9","7B.10"]},{"title":"ACC probes Hasina family over Purbachal plots","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"December 26, 2024","url":"https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/crime-justice/news/purbachal-plots-acc-probe-hasina-family-3785406","summary":"Claim: the ACC opened an investigation into alleged abuse of power in plot allocations to Hasina and family members. This is retrospective and post-ouster, so it is weak for in-office translation, but it is relevant to self-dealing and institutional weakness.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9","7B.10"]}]}
